summary: A 1901-02 cast-iron caisson tower at the mouth of Mount Hope Bay, built to replace a lightship, automated in 1964 and sold at auction in 2006.

access.note: Privately owned since 2006 auction; offshore, not open to the public.

corrections.why: 1886 is when Lightship No. 12 was moored on the shoal; the record's 1886 first_lit and 1886/1901 duplicate built events come from that. The tower dates from 1901-02.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: 1886 is the government lightship; the lighthouse itself is 1901-02. NRHP and LighthouseFriends differ on first lighting (Oct/Nov 1901) and completion (Mar 1902).

notes_for_editor: No 1902-1904 Light-House Board reports are in the corpus; the original lens (fifth vs fourth order) and first-lit date rest on LighthouseFriends, USLHS and NRHP, which disagree. Annual-report page numbers for sources 5, 6, 8 not determined (volume cited). Many LighthouseFriends facts (Walin, Hall, Toomey, riprap, 1962 log, 2006 auction, 2023-24 condition) are single-source; the Walin and 1962 log entries are quoted at LF from primary documents. A newspaper search (Chronicling America) did not return in time and was not used. Owners of the light are deliberately not named. Keeper roster comes from the USLHS archive (NARA registers); post-1959 Coast Guard names are as printed there. Fact-check 2026-10-27: Old Colony route differs between NRHP (Newport-Fall River) and LighthouseFriends (Fall River-New York), now stated in the text. Roster agrees with USLHS (LighthouseFriends prints Frank/Tom for Peloquin/Small). No OCR table matched by position beyond roster lines printed by the archive.
